title: GreenBoost readiness report
description: NemoClaw audit, Phase 6b. Adopts the SHAPE of NemoClaw's system-readiness.schema.json (five parallel ID'd collections, mutated:false enforced by the schema, status<->exitCode pinned, inconclusive a genuine third state) — re-implemented from scratch for GreenBoost's own signals (gb_readiness.py), not a fork. Produced by `python3 gb_readiness.py doctor --json` and `greenboost doctor --json`.

status.description: inconclusive is a genuine third state — used when an observation itself could not be determined (e.g. system_status erroring with 'NoneType has no attribute items' because the kernel module isn't loaded IS a finding, not a tool bug), never silently rounded to supported or incompatible.

exitCode.description: Pinned to status: supported->0, incompatible->2, inconclusive->3. 1 is reserved for 'the tool itself broke' (a Python exception in the report builder) and is never produced by a well-formed report — the CLI wrapper uses exit 1 only when this JSON was never produced at all.

mutated.description: Enforced false by the schema itself — a doctor that writes anything cannot validate. GreenBoost's own precedent: optimize_inference's GB_ORCH_ACTUATE read/write split.

value.description: the observed value — type varies by id

determined.description: false means the observation could not be made at all (distinct from a false/negative value that WAS determined)
